sources.title: AI features and your website
sources.supports: Google publicly describes query fan-out as multiple related searches across subtopics and data sources; it does not expose a general private-query inspection interface.

sources.title: Optimizing for generative AI features on Google Search
sources.supports: Google says normal SEO foundations remain relevant and warns against separate pages for every fan-out or query variation when created primarily to manipulate rankings or generative responses.

sources.title: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
sources.supports: Google recommends original, substantial, audience-first content with clear authorship, sourcing and production context rather than search-engine-first mass publishing.

sources.title: Spam policies for Google web search
sources.supports: Google defines scaled content abuse as many pages produced primarily to manipulate rankings while providing little original user value, regardless of production method.
